intelligent-console.title: Intelligent Copy Console
intelligent-console.heading: Intelligent Copy Console
intelligent-console.intro: Configure the generation service shared by intelligent interrupts and mute notices, validate generated copy with fixed simulated inputs, and review call records from the past seven days. Tests return results only to this page: they never send group messages, mute users, or change repeat state.

configuration.kicker: Shared by intelligent interrupts and mute notices
configuration.title: Generation service configuration

mode.label: Generation mode
mode.astrbot_help: Reuse an AstrBot-configured chat provider. Without a selected provider, production messages follow the triggering session; page tests require a selected and saved provider.
mode.manual_help: Call an OpenAI-compatible service directly without reading the AstrBot provider or model catalogs. Generation requires a saved API base URL, API key, and custom model ID.

provider.label: Chat provider
provider.help: Without a selected provider, production messages follow the triggering group-message session; this setting cannot be tested on this page.

manual_api_base.label: API Base URL
manual_api_base.help: OpenAI-compatible direct mode only. Enter the service root, including any required version path; generation also needs a saved API key and custom model ID.

manual_api_key.label: API Key
manual_api_key.placeholder: Leave blank to retain the saved key
manual_api_key.help: OpenAI-compatible direct mode only. Leave this input blank to retain a saved key; the page never displays it. Generation also needs an API base URL and custom model ID.
manual_api_key.configured: Saved; this page never displays the key.
manual_api_key.clear_confirm: Clear the saved API key? This saves immediately and cannot be undone.

model.label: Custom model ID
model.placeholder: AstrBot mode: leave blank unless overriding the chat provider's model
model.manual_placeholder: OpenAI-compatible direct mode requires a custom model ID
model.help: Use this only to override the selected AstrBot chat provider's model. Choose a candidate or enter a model ID.
model.manual_help: OpenAI-compatible direct mode requires a model ID; this page does not query third-party model catalogs.
model.blank_provider_help: Without a selected chat provider, production messages follow the triggering session and this page cannot run a test. A custom model ID still overrides that provider's model.
model.unavailable: Model candidates are unavailable; a custom model ID can still be entered.
model.provider_selected: Provider-selected model (no custom model ID specified)

runtime.mute_on: Intelligent mute notice: enabled after a successful mute

repeat.title: Intelligent interrupt generation test
repeat.description: Runs the saved intelligent-interrupt prompt against fixed simulated repeated content. Results return only to this page; no group message is sent and repeat state is unchanged.

mute.title: Intelligent mute-notice generation test
mute.description: Runs the saved intelligent-mute-notice prompt against “Test user / 60 seconds”. Results return only to this page; no user is muted, no group message is sent, and repeat state is unchanged.

history.kicker: Expand a record to view its input and result
history.title: Intelligent copy call records
history.empty: No call records match this time range.

clear.confirm: Clear all intelligent copy call records? This cannot be undone.

history.privacy: Records can include repeated content, requests, and generated results that can be expanded on this page. Data older than seven days is cleaned periodically in the background.

common.configuration_not_loaded: Load the saved configuration before saving changes.
common.unknown_error: The operation failed. Please try again later.
